name: whizzycommerce
description: Run a WhizzyCommerce shop from chat: orders, prices, sales, catalogue, translations and design. Reads are direct; every change is a preview the merchant confirms in the WhizzyCommerce dashboard.

interface.longDescription:
Connect your WhizzyCommerce shop and run it in plain language.

Ask which paid orders have not gone out, mark an order sent with its tracking number, draft a reply to a customer, raise prices across a collection, set up a discount code, write product descriptions, translate the shop, improve search titles, compare this month's sales with last month's, or edit the theme.

Reads are direct. Anything that would change the shop comes back as a preview of every row before and after, with a confirmation link: only the merchant, signed in to the WhizzyCommerce dashboard, can apply it. Section and page changes are drafts until the merchant publishes them; colours and fonts apply at once, each with an Undo. It can also build a theme of the merchant's own from scratch, kept private to their account, and try it on the shop as a draft. Every change is recorded in the shop's change log with who proposed and who confirmed it, and most can be undone from there.

When you connect, you sign in to WhizzyCommerce, pick the shop and approve the connection. Out of the box a connection may propose any change, each confirmed by the merchant; the merchant narrows that in the dashboard or picks a named role such as Analyst (reports only) or Shopkeeper (orders, catalogue, reports). No role includes refunds.
